results.question: How do I ask for a refund?
results.note: Plain how-to.
results.answer: To request a refund, open the Nimbus app, go to Payments, select the payment, and choose Request a refund. You will be asked for a reason. We review the request and tell you the outcome. Most requests are reviewed within one business day. Note: Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app, so you'll need to contact support instead for those.

citations.quote: Open the Nimbus app, go to Payments, select the payment, and choose Request a refund. You will be asked for a reason.
We review the request and tell you the outcome. Most requests are reviewed within one business day.

citations.section: If the app will not let you
citations.quote: Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app. Contact support instead.

results.question: What kinds of payments can Nimbus refund?
results.note: The overview article.
results.answer: Nimbus can refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment.

citations.quote: Nimbus can refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment.

results.question: Can I get a refund if I just changed my mind?
results.note: Answer is no. Both articles say it.
results.answer: No, Nimbus cannot refund a payment simply because you changed your mind. Refunds are only available for specific circumstances such as payments made in error, subscriptions cancelled within their cooling off period, or duplicate payments. If goods or services were received as described, the refund is a matter between you and the merchant.

citations.quote: We cannot refund a payment because you changed your mind.
Nimbus can refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment.

results.question: I cancelled my subscription five days after buying it, can I get my money back?
results.note: Inside the 14 day window.
results.answer: Yes, you can get a refund. Since you cancelled within 14 days of purchase, you are eligible for a refund. If you have not used the service, you will receive a full refund. If you have used the service during those 5 days, we will refund the unused portion, calculated daily.

citations.quote: Subscriptions bought through Nimbus can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund, provided you have not used the service.
If you have used the service during the 14 days, we refund the unused portion, calculated daily.

results.question: I cancelled a month after buying, do I get a partial refund?
results.note: Outside the window. Answer is no.
results.answer: No, you do not get a partial refund. After 14 days, the subscription runs to the end of its current term and we do not refund a partial term.

citations.quote: After 14 days the subscription runs to the end of its current term. We do not refund a partial term.

results.question: Can I get a refund on a gambling transaction?
results.note: Explicit exclusion.
results.answer: No, Nimbus cannot refund gambling transactions.

citations.section: When we cannot refund / Payments we cannot refund
citations.quote: We cannot refund gambling transactions, cryptocurrency purchases, or cash withdrawals.

results.question: Can a cash withdrawal be refunded?
results.note: Explicit exclusion.
results.answer: No, cash withdrawals cannot be refunded by Nimbus.

citations.section: When we cannot refund / Payments we cannot refund
citations.quote: We cannot refund gambling transactions, cryptocurrency purchases, or cash withdrawals.

results.question: The same payment came out twice, what do I do?
results.note: Straight duplicate payment.
results.answer: Report the duplicate payment in the app and Nimbus will verify it against the payment record themselves. If the same payment was taken twice, you will receive a refund in full for the duplicate.

citations.section: Duplicate payments / What we need from you
citations.quote: Report it in the app and we verify it against the payment record ourselves.
If the same payment was taken twice, we refund the duplicate in full.

results.question: How do I know whether a payment is a duplicate?
results.note: Same amount, same merchant, within 60 minutes.
results.answer: A duplicate has the same amount, the same merchant, and a timestamp within 60 minutes of the original.

citations.quote: A duplicate has the same amount, the same merchant, and a timestamp within 60 minutes of the original.

results.question: Do I need to send you a receipt for a duplicate payment?
results.note: Answer is nothing is needed.
results.answer: No, you do not need to send a receipt for a duplicate payment. You should report it in the app and Nimbus will verify it against the payment record themselves.

citations.quote: Nothing. Report it in the app and we verify it against the payment record ourselves.

results.question: My payment is still pending, should I request a refund?
results.note: Cancel is faster than refund.
results.answer: No, you should not request a refund for a pending payment. Instead, you should check whether the payment is still pending and cancel it if possible, as this is faster than requesting a refund.

citations.quote: Check whether the payment is still pending. Pending payments can often be cancelled instead, which is faster.

results.question: The payment was two years ago, can I still refund it in the app?
results.note: 180 day app limit. The archived article has a different 30 day rule.
results.answer: No, you cannot refund a payment that is two years old through the app. Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app. You will need to contact support instead.

citations.section: How to request a refund / If the app will not let you
citations.quote: Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app. Contact support instead.

results.question: How long after I request a refund will you tell me the outcome?
results.note: One business day to review. Not the same as the payout timescale.
results.answer: Most refund requests are reviewed within one business day, after which we tell you the outcome.

citations.section: How to request a refund / What happens next
citations.quote: Most requests are reviewed within one business day.

results.question: I used the subscription during the first 14 days, what happens to my refund?
results.note: Unused portion, calculated daily.
results.answer: If you have used the service during the 14 days, we refund the unused portion, calculated daily.

citations.quote: If you have used the service during the 14 days, we refund the unused portion, calculated daily.

results.question: Does the 14 day cooling off period apply to my business account?
results.note: Needs the business article to override the consumer one.
results.answer: No, the 14 day consumer cooling off period does not apply to business accounts. Business account refunds follow the terms in your business agreement, not the consumer terms. For refund requests on a business account, you should contact your account manager.

citations.quote: The 14 day consumer cooling off period does not apply to business accounts.
Business account refunds follow the terms in your business agreement, not the consumer terms in this help centre.
Business refund requests go to your account manager, not to general support.

results.question: Who do I contact about a refund on a business account?
results.note: Account manager, not general support.
results.answer: For business refund requests, you should contact your account manager, not general support. Business account refunds follow the terms in your business agreement rather than the consumer terms.

citations.quote: Business refund requests go to your account manager, not to general support.
Business account refunds follow the terms in your business agreement, not the consumer terms in this help centre.

results.question: My refund has not arrived yet, when should I chase it?
results.note: Current answer is 10 business days. Retired says 15, archived says 20.

results.question: How long does a refund take?
results.note: Three timescales tied on similarity. Only one is live.
results.answer: Once approved, a refund reaches your Nimbus account within 3 to 5 business days. If you paid by debit card, refunds usually arrive within 5 business days, though the card scheme controls the final step. If your refund has not arrived after 10 business days, you should contact support.

results.question: I bought a subscription through the App Store with my Nimbus card, can you refund it?
results.note: NIM-108 and NIM-109 contradict. Neither supersedes. Nimbus has not decided.
results.answer: Yes, Nimbus can refund your subscription purchased through the App Store with your Nimbus card. Contact Nimbus to request a refund, and we can raise the refund on your behalf.

citations.section: Subscriptions bought in an app store
citations.quote: Where a subscription was purchased through the Apple App Store or Google Play using your Nimbus card, contact Nimbus to request a refund. We can raise the refund on your behalf.

results.question: Who refunds a Google Play subscription, you or Google?
results.note: Same contradiction, different wording.
results.answer: It depends on how the subscription was billed. If you purchased the subscription through Google Play using your Nimbus card, Nimbus can raise the refund on your behalf. However, if the subscription is billed by Google Play (a third party), you must request the refund directly from Google Play, as Nimbus cannot issue the refund.

citations.section: Subscriptions bought in an app store
citations.quote: Where a subscription was purchased through the Apple App Store or Google Play using your Nimbus card, contact Nimbus to request a refund. We can raise the refund on your behalf.

citations.section: Subscriptions billed by a third party
citations.quote: Where a subscription is billed by a third party, including the Apple App Store and Google Play, Nimbus cannot issue a refund. The refund must be requested from the provider that billed you.

results.question: The merchant is refusing to refund me, what are my options?
results.note: This is a chargeback, which belongs to Triage disputes. Hand off.
results.answer: If a merchant is refusing to refund you and you paid by card, you may be able to raise a chargeback under the card scheme rules. You should contact the merchant about their returns policy first, as refunds are a matter between you and the merchant. If the merchant will not cooperate, the chargeback process may be available to you as a cardholder.

citations.quote: If a merchant will not refund you and you paid by card, you may be able to raise a chargeback under the card scheme rules.
